relationships.subject: VEGFA
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrated that VEGFA facilitates spare nerve injury-induced neuropathic pain through the Akt/TRPV1 pathway activation.

relationships.subject: sFlt1
relationships.evidence_quote: Soluble VEGFR1 (sFlt1) not only relieved mechanical hyperalgesia and the expression of inflammatory markers, but ameliorated the expression of VEGFA, VEGFR2, p-AKT, and TRPV1 in spinal cord.

relationships.subject: sFlt1
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas sFlt1 ameliorated the mechanical hypersensitivity significantly from day 3 to day 14

relationships.subject: 740 Y-P
relationships.evidence_quote: The nociceptive behavioral tests showed that the pain-relieving effect of sFlt1 was reversed by 740 Y-P (Figure 6).

relationships.subject: VEGFA
relationships.evidence_quote: However, the VEGFA agonist, rpVEGFA blocked the sFlt1 induced downregulation of IL-6, IL-1β, and TNF-α.

relationships.subject: VEGFA
relationships.evidence_quote: Since p-AKT/TRPV1 are downstream of VEGFA, we inferred that VEGFA participates in neuropathic pain may through the p-AKT/TRPV1 pathway

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of VEGFA was increased significantly after SNI model.

key_findings: Blocking VEGFA with sFlt1 relieved SNI-induced mechanical hypersensitivity and spinal cytokine expression, reversed by rpVEGFA or the AKT agonist 740 Y-P.
VEGFA acts via VEGFR2/AKT/TRPV1 in the spinal dorsal horn after nerve injury.
